move: warm blurred blobs breathe and swap places under live film grain
how: Four 820px circles in orange, hot pink, gold and plum, blurred 110px, sit on deep brown; two full-frame SVG feTurbulence layers (fine grain soft-light, coarse grain overlay) and a radial vignette lie on top. Each blob slides on a short diagonal and back (b1 +220/+120, b2 -260/+140) or scales 1 to 1.25 / 1 to 0.85 with sine.inOut yoyo over one cycle per D. Every frame the fine noise seed advances (30 per second, cycling 120) and the coarse seed steps 6 per second, so the grain crawls like film; both seeds return to their start at D.
adapt: Change the four blob colours and the background tint, blob size and blur, and the grain strength via the two layer opacities. Keep the yoyo cycles whole per D and the seed cycle lengths so grain and blobs both loop.
port: mount(el, shot) adds the blobs, the two filter SVGs with unique filter ids and the vignette; animate(el, shot, D) returns the blob timeline plus a linear progress tween whose onUpdate sets the two feTurbulence seed attributes from the current time, replacing the window.__fx.seek override. Filter ids must be unique per instance.
caveats: filter: blur(110px) on four large layers plus two full-frame feTurbulence filters is slow to render
grain seeding is done by patching window.__fx.seek, not on the timeline
